template: Open {{v1}} in the browser. If the Grafana login page appears, sign in with username 'admin' and password 'admin'; if Grafana then asks you to change the admin password, click 'Skip'. provenance.instruction: Open http://127.0.0.1:3000/ in the browser. If the Grafana login page appears, sign in with username 'admin' and password 'admin'; if Grafana then asks you to change the admin password, click 'Skip'. Then find and open the provisioned dashboard named 'Service health' (use the Dashboards search in the left menu).
